snippet.title: Pixel Wizard  - announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Just released my steam page for Pixel Wizard!

A medieval fantasy hack and slash adventure where you are a battle pixel wizard.
Fast and frantic, fight hordes of enemies and defeat brutal bosses in any order to save the kingdom. 
Use deadly magic, powerful items and valuable loot to help turn the tide of battle. 

Wish-list on steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3782650/Pixel_Wizard/
